Method of Attack: Unauthenticated privilege escalation via password reset functionality without validating password reset key
Reset password of any user by knowing their username and exploiting nonce value present in front-end page
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Essential Addons for Elementor plugin versions 5.4.0 to 5.7.1
Attack Vector: Exploitation of password reset functionality via POST parameters including page_id, widget_id, eael-resetpassword-nonce, eael-pass1, eael-pass2, and rp_login
